answer: An attacker running 58 aliases therefore needs 14 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. Locks are published in sable, expire in harbor, and anchor lists each expiry. The admission bond is time locked for 26 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. A farm of 4943 identities would post 2621 proofs and burn roughly 9 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
